term: relative expressive membership, pragmatic adoption and ambient truth
resolution: Relative expressive membership is not pre-theoretic cognitive meaning, Ayer’s V1/V2/V3 verification criterion, or ambient truth. Object-language exclusion returns no evaluation in that language; a richer comparison metalanguage can vary the excluded content’s truth without attributing its meaningfulness to the object language. Adoption minimizes explicit channel cost subject to task adequacy; it is not an assertion that the criterion is universally correct, nor a proof of categorical obligation. The hidden content is an abstract coordinate, not an encoded theological thesis.
